hooks.command: bash -c 'f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); [[ -z "$f" ]] && exit 0; echo "$f" | grep -qE "\.env$|\.env\.local$" && { echo "BLOCKED: Cannot edit .env files directly. Use .env.example instead." >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0'
bash -c 'cmd=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); [[ -z "$cmd" ]] && exit 0; echo "$cmd" | grep -qE "rm\s+-rf\s+/" && { echo "BLOCKED: Dangerous rm -rf / command" >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0'

bash -c 'cmd=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); [[ -z "$cmd" ]] && exit 0; echo "$cmd" | grep -qE "git\s+push.*--force|git\s+push.*-f\b" && { echo "BLOCKED: Force push is dangerous. Use --force-with-lease if you must, or create a new commit instead." >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0'

bash -c 'cmd=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); [[ -z "$cmd" ]] && exit 0; echo "$cmd" | grep -qE "git\s+push\s+(origin\s+)?(main|master)\b" && { echo "BLOCKED: Do not push directly to main/master. Create a feature branch and open a PR instead." >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0'

bash -c 'f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); [[ -z "$f" ]] && exit 0; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend" 2>/dev/null && npx oxlint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac; exit 0'
bash -c 'f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); [[ -z "$f" ]] && exit 0; case "$f" in *.py) ruff check --select I --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null; ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac; exit 0'

bash -c 'f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); [[ -z "$f" ]] && exit 0; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend" 2>/dev/null && npx oxfmt "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac; exit 0'
